expect_red: a feature's body says what it is: bound with its face, part number, Correct, Add a face, Unbind and Flip; not bound with Pick a face on its own part; a suggestion the pane lists is the pane's rows; an armed end is its line and Cancel

mutations.contract: Pick and Correct arm the pick on the feature's OWN part.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_binding_shows_the_moment_it_is_made_and_is_corrected_where_it_is_shown (2026-11-12). Drops the part, so a node two parts share arms whichever part the end lists first.

mutations.contract: Flip is offered only where the dimension's other end is free.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_binding_shows_the_moment_it_is_made_and_is_corrected_where_it_is_shown (2026-11-12). Offers Flip into an end that already has a face.

mutations.contract: Add a face arms the same pick as Correct, in the mode that adds.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_pattern_is_bound_as_its_like_faces_and_a_face_can_be_added (2026-11-15). Drops the mode, so Add a face is a second Correct and replaces the set it was meant to grow.
mutations.find: return { text: W.addFace, title: W.addFaceTitle, command: verb(V.arm, e).concat([VA.ARM_ADD]) };
mutations.replace: return { text: W.addFace, title: W.addFaceTitle, command: verb(V.arm, e) };
